source_name: Modelica Standard Library — explicit equation-section equalities

official_access.access_mode: Resolve a stable official MSL release tag and its exact commit, acquire that release on an external executor, and process the published Modelica/**/*.mo source tree. Do not scrape rendered documentation pages.

scope.corpus: Published Modelica package source in a stable Modelica Standard Library release
structures: simple equality equations in equation sections
simple equality equations in initial equation sections
electrical, magnetic, mechanical, thermal and fluid equations
conditional equalities with source control context
array and vector equalities expressed in Modelica syntax
scope.original_representation: exact lexical Modelica equality statement, including the terminating semicolon, as stored in the .mo source file
scope.batching: one stable MSL release tag + exact Git commit + deterministic Modelica source inventory per extraction/materialization batch
exclusions: algorithm sections and := assignments are not equations in this lane
connect clauses are topology and are not emitted as equation occurrences
assert, reinit and terminate calls are not emitted as equality occurrences
documentation prose and formulas appearing only inside HTML annotations are not harvested by this source-code lane
the adapter does not flatten inheritance, resolve replaceable classes, infer units through the type system, or symbolically transform expressions at extracted stage

snapshot_policy.rule: At run time resolve the stable official MSL release selected for acquisition to its exact Git commit; SHA-256 every included .mo file; sort the path/size/hash inventory deterministically; and use modelica-msl:release:<tag>:git:<commit>:inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot. The descriptor does not encode a mutable 'latest' version. A different release, commit, file set or byte inventory creates a new immutable snapshot and Internet Archive item.

license_policy.rule: Retain the Modelica Association/contributor copyright notice, BSD 3-Clause conditions and disclaimer with redistributed source-derived data. Preserve release, commit, source path and record hashes for attribution/provenance. Any vendored third-party asset outside the scoped Modelica .mo source tree requires an independent rights decision and is excluded by default.

adapter.input: repository root of one verified MSL release checkout; when a Modelica/ directory is present the adapter scopes traversal to Modelica/**/*.mo
validation: expression_original is the exact lexical simple equality statement from an equation or initial equation section, including the terminating semicolon
comments and strings are masked only for lexical boundary detection and do not alter emitted source bytes
semicolon separators inside parentheses, brackets or braces do not terminate an occurrence
if/elseif/else, when/elsewhen and for equation control context is retained when expressed in the line-oriented MSL source style

source_record_sha256 is independent of the executor checkout directory and depends on source id, immutable snapshot, repository-relative source path, document bytes, equation ordinal, expression bytes, class path and section
algorithm assignments, connect clauses, assert/reinit/terminate calls, documentation text, OCR and reconstructed equations are excluded from extracted output
no semantic flattening, algebraic equivalence or equation-family assertion occurs at extracted stage
